For a 50-person Indian company, I’d shortlist these three managed-travel options:

Provider	What differentiates it	Indicative cost
MakeMyTrip for Business	India-focused, easy self-booking, GST invoices, corporate rates and last-minute modifications. 
MakeMyTrip Biz
	Usually transaction-based; quote required
ITILITE	More complete travel + expense workflow, policy controls and employee-focused UX; suited to growing companies. 
HappyFares
	Roughly ₹1.5–4 lakh/year for a 50-person company, depending on usage/plan
FCM Travel	Full-service TMC with human support, corporate travel management, negotiated rates and stronger global-program capabilities. 
FCM Travel
	Custom quote; typically more service-heavy

How I’d distinguish them: MMT is the simpler India-first option; ITILITE is the software-heavy middle ground; FCM is the more traditional managed TMC choice if employees need human assistance and the company wants tighter programme management.

For 50 employees, ask each for booking fees, cancellation/reissue charges, hotel markups, GST/ITC handling, 24×7 support and minimum annual spend before comparing quotes.
